## Items (last 24h)

1. **[CMRL]** Poonamallee Bypass–Vadapalani metro fares fixed ₹10–₹40 (14.64 km, 11 elevated stations, Corridor 4); proposed Oct 11 inauguration by PM Modi; fares unchanged since 2015. — DT Next, Sep 29: https://www.dtnext.in/news/chennai/poonamalleevadapalani-metro-fare-to-start-at-rs-10-maximum-rs-40
2. **[CMRL]** TBM Kaveri broke through at Kilpauk Medical College station — 685 m drive from Chetpet, Phase 2 Corridor 3. — Deccan Chronicle, Sep 30: https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/tamil-nadu/tbm-kaveri-breaks-through-at-kilpauk-medical-college-1991757
3. **[SR]** Adambakkam MRTS station (Velachery–St Thomas Mount extension) opened Mar 14 but no train stops there — platform gap ~20 cm over permitted limit on curve; CRS approval awaited, fix targeted year-end. — Indian Express Tamil, Sep 29: https://tamil.indianexpress.com/tamilnadu/adambakkam-mrts-station-non-operational-platform-gap-issue-velachery-st-thomas-mount-line-12589062
4. **[TNSTC]** 5,300 special buses Oct 1–4 for the Gandhi Jayanti long weekend; 1,215 from Chennai's Kilambakkam, Koyambedu, Madhavaram termini. — DT Next, Sep 30: https://www.dtnext.in/news/tamilnadu/5300-special-buses-gandhi-jayanti-weekend-tamil-nadu-october-1-4
5. **[TNSTC]** TN private bus operators' 24-h strike (excl. Chennai, Madurai, Nagercoil, Ooty) called off after minister assurances; demands: fare revision + subsidy for extending women's free-travel scheme to private buses. — Times of India (PTI), Sep 29: https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/coimbatore/tamil-nadu-private-bus-owners-call-off-proposed-strike/articleshow/134568189.cms
6. **[CMRL]** Reported: tender for 28 Phase-1 trains (6-car) has been deferred 11 times in 10 months with no bidders. — @titoraja on X, Sep 29 (dropped from final thread for length): https://x.com/titoraja/status/2104802983842316584
